hero.badge: Sri Lanka's first real-time donor matching platform
hero.subtitle: Suwa Sarana connects voluntary blood donors with patients across Sri Lanka — instantly, intelligently, and in your language.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps to save a life
howItWorks.step1Desc: Create your account, provide your blood type, and share your location. Donors set availability; requesters create patient profiles.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our engine instantly matches compatible, eligible donors near the hospital — using geospatial scoring and reliability ratings.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Matched donors receive real-time alerts, confirm availability, and donate. The request auto-escalates if no response in time.

features.title: Built for real emergencies
features.subtitle: Every feature designed to save time when every minute counts
features.geoDesc: PostGIS-powered radius search finds the closest compatible donors first, then auto-expands if no match is found.
features.sseDesc: Donors receive instant Server-Sent Event alerts the moment a matching request is raised in their area.
features.escalationDesc: Automated escalation every 15 minutes widens the search radius until a match is confirmed or the request expires.
features.reliabilityDesc: Donors earn score for confirmed donations; no-shows are penalized — prioritising the most reliable donors first.

cta.title: Be someone's hero today
cta.subtitle: One unit of blood can save up to three lives. Register as a donor and be ready when your community needs you most.
